title: intentions-model-compiler
intention: The single owner-gated door that compiles the `intentions-congruency-lab/` MODEL — regenerating `intentions-congruency-lab/` as a pure projection from its sources (`intentions-not-beside-code/` plus the charters homed beside the code), so that one folder can be carried to a bare machine and regrow the system (CLAUDE.md: `intentions-congruency-lab/` is COMPILED from `intentions-not-beside-code/` plus the charters). It is reached exactly ONE way (its compile door) but POKED from three: `cairn compile` from the CLI (via cairn-command), the `/sorted` resolution pivot, and a WRITE GATE that fires when a source changes (the live recompile-on-change path — the file-watching that was moved to GATES, event-driven, not a poller). The name says MODEL on purpose: right now the folder IS the model, so this compiles the model. `intentions-compiler` is reserved (unbuilt, no intention yet) for a possible future front-end that ingests a page of authored prose INTO intentions — a distinct concern the reserved name keeps free.
why: Law 4 + the roots table: a compiled view is never hand-edited, and `intentions-congruency-lab/` is the carry-to-a-bare-machine model — so it must be REGENERABLE from its sources by physics, not kept current by whoever remembers to. That regeneration needs one write-door (Law 6 — exactly one owner gates writes to `intentions-congruency-lab/`) and a proof a hollow build could not pass (Law 8 — a compile that silently drops or mangles a source is the defect). Poked-from-many-but-one-door is the shape: the CLI hand-crank, the /sorted pivot, and the write gate all POKE the same door, none of them writes `intentions-congruency-lab/` themselves. Kin to the PROJECTOR (charter-state-history-split — state compiled from a component's history): same pattern (pure projection, single append/write door, never hand-edited), different corpus (per-component state vs the system-wide intentions model) and different owner — cross-referenced, NOT merged (asked the why of each: local-component-truth vs carry-to-bare-machine-model — not exclusive-and-terminal).
traces_to: Law 4 (a rule that matters is physics — `intentions-congruency-lab/` is regenerable from sources, not hand-maintained; the 'compiled view is never hand-edited' IOU in CLAUDE.md 'Rules awaiting physics')
Law 6 (exactly one owner gates writes to `intentions-congruency-lab/` — the compile door; every trigger pokes it, none writes directly)
Law 1 (the model is compiled once from structure, not re-derived by each reader — the same move as the projector, one corpus out)
Law 8 (the compile carries a proof a hollow build could not pass — a dropped/mangled source goes RED)
the roots table (CLAUDE.md: `intentions-congruency-lab/` is COMPILED from `intentions-not-beside-code/` + the beside-code charters — the folder carried to a bare machine to regrow the system)
kinship: charter-state-history-split (the projector — same projection pattern, different corpus/owner; cross-referenced not merged)

falsifier.proves_green: proof gate (tester) — a proof a hollow build could not pass: give the compiler a known set of sources (`intentions-not-beside-code/` entries + beside-code charters) and assert the projected `intentions-congruency-lab/` contains exactly what the sources imply — every source represented, nothing invented, a changed source changes its output, a REMOVED source removes its projection (no stale carry-over); assert `intentions-congruency-lab/` is written ONLY through the compile door (a hand-edit is overwritten on next compile — the view is never authoritative); assert the compile is DETERMINISTIC (same sources -> same output, so drift is detectable). VALIDATION persisted beside-code via cairn/devices/tester/validation_store.persist_validation and grep back. Durability gate: proven, persisted, committed (git).
falsifier.proves_red: the compiler regenerates `intentions-congruency-lab/` as a faithful, deterministic projection of its sources — every source represented, nothing invented, removals propagated, a hand-edit to `intentions-congruency-lab/` reverted on next compile (the view is never a record of truth). Wrong-shape signals: (1) `intentions-congruency-lab/` is written by any door OTHER than the compiler (a second writer — Law 6 breach); (2) the compile is non-deterministic or lossy (a source silently dropped — Law 8 defect, and drift becomes invisible); (3) the compiler starts AUTHORING content not in its sources (it has become an editor, not a projector — the compiled view has become a rival record of truth, Law 7); (4) it grows to also own the projector's job (per-component state) — the two corpora collapsed when they were meant to stay distinct vantages; (5) it grows its OWN nightly scanner (that work belongs to the inspector regime — a compiler that inspects has taken on a second job it does not own).
falsifier.horizon: first real recompile-on-write — when a charter or `intentions-not-beside-code/` source is written, a GATE fires, pokes this door, and `intentions-congruency-lab/` regenerates without a human running anything; re-check then: is beside-code source-walking fast enough on every write, or does the gate need to hand the compiler a CHANGED-SET rather than trigger a full reprojection? And revisit the projector kinship — if the two compilers end up sharing real projection machinery, factor the shared core out (not before the second member proves the seam).
